Name: Show XP and Level Gains
Author: adverserath
Description:
When performing any action which gives experience the player will receive a Debris notification indicating how much experience has been awarding within the last second (so multiple experience stacks)

The colour will also indicate which skill the experience belongs to.
Gray - Mining
Green - Farming
Blue - Fishing
YellowGreen - Foraging
Orange - Combat


You'll spot things you may not have known, like:
- Coloured stones dont give XP mining
- Stumps only give you 1 xp, but the tree is 12xp
- If you get coal on a rock, you get 5xp
- Bombs give the same XP as mining. (Total XP is grouped per second on the mod, so you get a single value for everything gained)

You'll quickly learn that the tasks you constantly do, arent worth doing when you focus on level gains
